title: A 0-bit MeshSTL position with coordinates is precise, Position or MapReport
reasoning: Casey, issue #55 comment 6989099568, item 2 (verbatim): "pos_04 in PR #71: my item 8 is about privacy, not the message type. Any 0-bit MeshSTL position that carries coordinates, Position or MapReport, gets precise_source true when seen_meshstl is true." PR #71 words pos_04: "or a position with `precision_bits` 0 that carries coordinates, Position or MapReport, is flagged `precise_source = true` exactly when `seen_meshstl` is true on its delivery". Firmware older than the precision field sends 0 bits with full-precision coordinates.

The decoder stores a MapReport's coordinates whenever either is non-zero, with precision_bits from position_precision, which can be 0 (ingester/decoder.py lines 264 to 274), so a 0-bit MapReport with coordinates reaches raw.

s04-m001 is a Position at 0 bits carried by the MeshSTL broker only, near 38.60 N, 90.34 W, inside the MSA. It stays unusable with null cell_width_i and half-widths (pos_01 is unchanged), and it is precise_source true. Its only copy is in core, precise.

s04-m002 is a MapReport at 0 bits carried by the MeshSTL broker only, near 38.60 N, 90.33 W, inside the MSA. Under the revised item 8 the message type does not matter: unusable, precise_source true, in core, precise.

s04-m003 is a Position at 0 bits from s04-c in both snapshots: at 09:20:00 in a, public only, and at 09:20:05 in b, MeshSTL only. In stg_position a's copy is not precise and b's is. Core keeps a's copy, the first, and reads seen_meshstl on any copy (Casey, issue #55 comment 6985802330, item 7), so core's flag is true; the incremental build after snapshot b loads must set it on the row core already keeps.

s04-m004 is the same path for a MapReport at 0 bits from s04-d: at 09:30:00 in a, public only, and at 09:30:05 in b, MeshSTL only. a's copy is not precise in staging, b's is, and core keeps a's copy with the flag set once b loads.

s04-m005 is a Position at 0 bits at 0, 0, carried by the MeshSTL broker only. PR #71 defines carrying coordinates: "a position carries coordinates when `latitude_i` and `longitude_i` are both present and `pos_03` does not map it to no position, so a report at 0, 0 is not flagged" (Casey, PR #71 comment 6989275630, item 1). pos_03 maps a Position at 0, 0 to no position, so it carries no coordinates: in stg_position its latitude_i and longitude_i are null, position_zero_mapped is true and it is counted with the other mapped rows, and its quality and precise flag are null. With no position it is not inside the MSA (pos_02) and never reaches core. A MapReport at 0, 0 cannot be built here: the decoder lands one with no position_source (ingester/decoder.py lines 266 to 268).

Expected positions, by hand: s04-m001 to s04-m004 are inside the MSA and unusable at 0 bits, none at 0, 0 (the MapReports carry non-zero coordinates), and core keeps one precise row for each. s04-m005 has no position: zero-mapped, no quality, no precise flag, not inside, not in core.
